code: g_resolver_records_from_res_query (const gchar *rrname, gint rrtype, const guint8 *answer, gssize len, gint herr, GError **error)
note: The fuzzed DNS response bytes enter the resolver parser as answer with the input size in len.
The only size check rejects non-positive lengths, but the parser also needs the DNS message to contain a complete HEADER before reading header fields.
The input buffer is treated as a DNS HEADER even when len is smaller than sizeof (HEADER).
Reading qdcount from the assumed DNS header accesses bytes beyond the one-byte input buffer.
